title: Beyond Fixed-Context Likelihood: Zero-Shot AI-Generated Text Detection via Context Perturbation Discrepancy
abstract: arXiv:2611.32778v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The same increase in token log probability from earlier context can be typical at one position and unusually large at another. We introduce Context Perturbation Discrepancy (CPD), a zero-shot detector that measures this gain relative to what a single pretrained language model expects. Keeping the passage fixed, CPD scores each observed token under its full prefix and under a short window of recent tokens. Under the full-prefix distribution, the expected gain equals the KL divergence from that distribution to the restricted-prefix distribution. CPD subtracts this expectation from each observed gain and scales the sum of the signed deviations by its analytical reference standard deviation. On unedited human and AI texts from GEN, DetectRL-X, and HART, subtracting the expected gain raises AUROC by 32.78-35.81 percentage points at the same variance scale. CPD outperforms seven zero-shot baselines, averaging 94.80% AUROC and 79.60% recall at

translated_title: 超越固定上下文似然：基于上下文扰动差异的零样本AI生成文本检测
translated_abstract: 来自较早上下文的相同token对数概率增量，在某些位置可能是典型现象，而在另一些位置则可能异常大。我们提出了上下文扰动差异（Context Perturbation Discrepancy, CPD），这是一种零样本检测器，它相对于单个预训练语言模型的期望来衡量这种增益。在保持文本段落固定不变的情况下，CPD在每个观测token的完整前缀和最近token的短窗口两种条件下对其进行评分。在完整前缀分布下，期望增益等于该分布到受限前缀分布的KL散度。CPD从每个观测到的增益中减去这一期望，并用其解析参考标准差对带符号偏差之和进行缩放。在来自GEN、DetectRL-X和HART的未经编辑的人类与AI文本上，在相同的方差尺度下，减去期望增益使AUROC提高了32.78至35.81个百分点。CPD优于七个零样本基线方法，平均达到94.80%的AUROC和79.60%的召回率。
tldr: 提出零样本AI生成文本检测方法CPD，通过衡量token对数概率增益相对于完整前缀分布期望的偏离程度（上下文扰动差异）来识别AI文本，在多个数据集上显著超越七个零样本基线，平均AUROC达94.80%。
en_tdlr: Proposes CPD, a zero-shot AI-generated text detector that measures the discrepancy between observed token log-probability gains and the expectation under a full-prefix distribution, significantly outperforming seven zero-shot baselines with an average AUROC of 94.80%.
